subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity pricing & GPU sizing — next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Michaels <jordan.michaels@acmeai.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmeai.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity pricing & GPU sizing — next steps

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we can get you a firm Dedicated proposal: 

Summary of what we heard (please flag any corrections):
- Primary workload: interactive chat + short-document search reranking (avg prompt + completion = ~600 tokens).
- Expected steady-state traffic: roughly 1.2M tokens/day (petite peak days could be 1.8M). Rough monthly baseline ~36M tokens.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 200ms; p99 goal < 350ms for 512-token responses.
- Budget guidance (initial): $6–$10 per 1M tokens; procurement is leaning toward the middle/high end depending on performance guarantees.
- Preference: you mentioned leaning toward H100s for peak throughput and future-proofing.

Open questions / items Redwood will action: 
1) Map token volume -> recommended GPU count and reserved sizing (we'll include A100/H100 options + expected unit economics).
2) Provide a price ladder (1 GPU, 2 GPU, 4 GPU reserved configs) with $/1M token estimates and estimated latency/throughput.
3) Attach token-estimate workbook and sample traffic modelling for your review.
4) SOC2 + security checklist (Priya asked for evidence, we will attach SOC2 summary and control docs if useful).

Next steps / asks from Acme AI: 
- Confirm whether you have a hard cap on monthly spend or a target $/1M token we should prioritize when sizing.
- Share a 2-week traffic sample (or API logs) if possible — this will materially tighten the GPU sizing recommendation.
- Availability for a 30-min follow-up on Wed or Thu next week to review the configuration matrix (I've proposed times in the calendar invite).

Attachments: Acme_token_estimates.xlsx (token projections + modeling) — see tab "baseline-vs-peaks".

I'll follow up with a short configuration summary by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Michaels <jordan.michaels@acmeai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmeai.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated capacity pricing & GPU sizing — next steps

Camila —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifications from our side: 
- The 1.2M tokens/day is our expected steady state; however our product team expects bursty growth during marketing campaigns (we should plan for 2–3x burst capacity temporarily, not sustained).
- On budget: procurement signaled they'd be comfortable at around $9/1M tokens if we can get p95 latency under 200ms and a clear SLA. $6 would be tough without aggressive quantization or storage/caching tradeoffs.
- GPU preference: H100 is preferred for now; we can consider A100 as a cost-savings option if the numbers justify it.

Action for you: Please include a short table showing total monthly cost and implied $/1M tokens for each reserved config (1x, 2x, 4x GPUs) and an estimate of how many concurrent chats those configs can sustain (assume avg 2 concurrent requests per active user). Also, flag if autoscaling/bursting beyond reserved is available and what that looks like from a billing perspective.

I'll pull the sample logs — should have them to you by Tuesday EOD.

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Platform, Acme AI
jordan.michaels@acmeai.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Michaels <jordan.michaels@acmeai.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmeai.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 07:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated capacity pricing & GPU sizing — next steps

Thanks Jordan — attaching the short config matrix and the token-estimates workbook (linked in the first email). I also attached our initial pricing PDF so procurement has a single doc to review: Redwood_dedicated_pricing_v1.pdf (summary below).

Quick proposal (ballpark numbers — final quote once we have logs):

Configuration A — 2 x NVIDIA H100 (reserved)
- Target throughput: ~420 tokens/sec sustained (aggregate)
- Expected p95 latency for 512-token responses: ~180ms
- Monthly reserved cost (list, example): $36,000
- Implied unit economics: ~$9.2 per 1M tokens (based on 36M tokens/mo)

Configuration B — 4 x NVIDIA H100 (reserved)
- Target throughput: ~900 tokens/sec sustained
- Expected p95 latency for 512-token responses: ~120ms
- Monthly reserved cost (list, example): $68,000
- Implied unit economics: ~$6.5 per 1M tokens (based on 36M tokens/mo)

Configuration C — 2 x NVIDIA A100 (80GB) (reserved, cost-savings option)
- Target throughput: ~320 tokens/sec sustained
- Expected p95 latency: ~220ms
- Monthly reserved cost (list, example): $28,000
- Implied unit economics: ~$11.5 per 1M tokens

Notes / important callouts:
- Bursting: Redwood Dedicated supports controlled burst capacity onto a shared burst pool (subject to availability). Burst is metered at an overage rate; we'll put that rate in the formal quote.
- Autoscaling: We can configure policies so the cluster scales additional worker capacity when queue depth/latency thresholds are breached; for procurement purpose that adds variable costs but keeps UX consistent.
- Caching: With a 20% effective prefix/KV cache hit (typical for your reranking patterns), economics improve ~15% — we'll run the workbook with cache assumptions when we have logs.
- Contract term tradeoffs: 12mo reserved gives the best per-1M price; 3mo pilot term prices are ~15–25% higher.

Attachments included: Redwood_dedicated_pricing_v1.pdf; Acme_token_estimates.xlsx

I put the configuration table in the attached PDF and the workbook. Rafael (cc) is looping in our infra lead and will be available if you want a deep dive on latency profiling.

Next steps: 
- Jordan / Priya: share logs by EOD Tue (you mentioned Tuesday) — we'll generate a finalized GPU-count recommendation and a detailed cost sheet within 48 hours of receiving logs.
- Let's tentatively schedule a 30-min sync Thurs 4PM PT to review the final sizing. I'll send invites once we confirm availability.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

---
Attachment stubs:
- Redwood_dedicated_pricing_v1.pdf (12 pages; pricing ladder, SLA terms, burst/overage rates)
- Acme_token_estimates.xlsx (tabs: baseline-vs-peaks, cache-scenarios, per-config-costs)

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmeai.com>

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated capacity pricing & GPU sizing — next steps

Camila / Jordan —

Thanks — PDF looks good at a glance. Procurement will want the following in the formal quote: 
- Clear monthly committed cost + overage pricing (per-1M tokens or per-hour GPU overage)
- SLA p95/p99 targets and remedies
- Security pack (SOC2 report + encryption at rest details) — happy to accept a redacted SOC2 for initial review.

Jordan, I can confirm calendar Thursday 4PM PT. Camila, can you send a 30-min invite and include Rafael/Neha? Also, please add the HubSpot deal link and a DocuSign placeholder to the quote so procurement can prep internally.

Priya Singh
